title: Review operation on same value
why: This pattern often indicates unfinished, redundant, or error-prone code.
suggestion: Clarify the intent or replace the suspicious construct.
limitations: Self-inequality comparisons and paired ternary self-comparisons are treated as intentional NaN detection; Python comment text is excluded, while equality comparisons on the same value remain reportable outside recognized assertions and NaN contexts.
Comparisons against a cast or otherwise extended expression are excluded because the two operands are not equivalent.
